strings.en: The Pokémon League added more train{NEWLINE}services to make travel easier. Now you{CLEAR}can catch a train anytime you come to{CLEAR}Saffron City.

strings.zh: 为了方便关东和城都地区的沟通,{NEWLINE}精灵联盟主持修建了这条{CLEAR}横穿石英高原的高速铁路,{CLEAR}将关东最大的城市金黄市{CLEAR}和城都最大的城市满金市连接了起来。
strings.en: To connect Kanto and Johto, the{NEWLINE}Pokémon League built this high-speed{CLEAR}railway across the Indigo Plateau. It{CLEAR}links Saffron City, Kanto’s biggest{CLEAR}city, with Goldenrod City, Johto’s{CLEAR}biggest city.

Seeing this young man singing at the{NEWLINE}station for his musical dream reminds me{CLEAR}of my own dream of becoming a singer{CLEAR}when I was young.
